title: ID0458573-DC/Si-D/UK-[MP / P1 170000136] RFID and SCB issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue-
RFID and SCB issue
Solution: RFID is ON always after v8 to avoid screen interactions and Delete AC outlet in the following manner:
Set required outlet to 0 in PLC config - save and reboot
Delete outlet in Outlet Config - BUT DON'T SAVE YET
Ensure the other outlet numbers are now correct - e.g. deleting the AC outlet, the DC outlet UI Outlet Number should be moved from 3 to 2
Save and reboot
